$description: Entity-keyed Italian overlay. Generated from the translator's existing Annex A cell translations so that no hand-authored Italian is lost when the calendar became data-driven. Keys are entity IDs plus a field name, so they survive DOM changes — unlike the positional annex-a.tdN keys they were extracted from.
